title: (Senior) Consultant Corporate Treasury (w/m/d)
description: Du willst mit Deiner Expertise in dem Bereich Corporate Treasury unsere Kund:innen beraten und unterstützen? Dann kannst Du Dich hier einbringen: Du bist für die fachliche Beratung unserer Mandant:innen in der Entwicklung und Einführung der Organisation, Methoden, Prozesse und Finanzrisikostrategien bis zu deren Umsetzung in entsprechenden Treasury-IT-Systemen im Rahmen von Transformationsprojekten oder Unternehmenstransaktionen verantwortlich. Dazu zählt ebenfalls die Neueinführung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Treasury Management-Systeme sowie die Optimierung des Berichtswesens unserer Mandant:innen mit den gängigen Berichtswerkzeugen. Du hilfst bei der Optimierung des Zahlungsverkehrs einschließlich Payment Factories, Inhouse Banken oder der Harmonisierung von Formaten und Bankenkommunikation. Der Aufbau von Cash Management-Strukturen, einschließlich Bankenstrategie sowie Liquiditätsplanungsprozessen, -methodiken und -systemen zählt ebenfalls zu Deinem Aufgabengebiet. Du unterstützt bei der Identifizierung, Quantifizierung sowie dem Aufbau von Steuerungslogiken und -strategien im Währungs-, Zins- und Kreditrisikomanagement. Du übernimmst die fachliche Beratung und Umsetzung von Rechnungslegungsstandards für Finanzinstrumente sowie deren Bewertung. Darüber hinaus wirkst Du aktiv bei der Identifizierung und Steuerung von Rohstoff- und Energiepreisrisiken bei Industrie- und Versorgungsunternehmen mit.
description_en: Do you want to advise and support our customers with your expertise in the area of ​​corporate treasury? Then you can get involved here: You are responsible for providing our clients with professional advice on the development and introduction of the organization, methods, processes and financial risk strategies through to their implementation in appropriate treasury IT systems as part of transformation projects or corporate transactions. This also includes the introduction and further development of existing treasury management systems as well as the optimization of our clients' reporting using common reporting tools. You help optimize payment transactions including payment factories, in-house banks or the harmonization of formats and bank communication. The development of cash management structures, including banking strategy as well as liquidity planning processes, methodologies and systems, is also part of your area of ​​responsibility. You support the identification, quantification and development of control logic and strategies in currency, interest and credit risk management. You will provide technical advice and implementation of accounting standards for financial instruments as well as their evaluation. In addition, you will be actively involved in identifying and managing raw material and energy price risks at industrial and utility companies.

title: Junior Consultant Accounting Advisory Services - Lucanet (w/m/d)
description: Du willst mit Deiner Expertise unseren Bereich Accounting Advisory Services stärken? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und bringe dich mit ein: Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen – vom Mittelstand bis hin zu internationalen Konzernen – bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer Finance-Funktion. Dabei unterstützt Du sie bei der Optimierung von Prozessen rund um Konzernabschlusserstellung, Reporting und Financial Performance Management sowie bei der Umsetzung regulatorischer Anforderungen nach IFRS und HGB. Wesentlicher Fokus Deiner Tätigkeit liegt auf der Implementierung und Optimierung von Lucanet Consolidation & Financial Planning (CFP) als maßgebliche FPM-Software. Mit deinem Konsolidierungswissen begleitest Du unsere Kund:innen bei der Abbildung komplexer Konzernstrukturen sowie der Weiterentwicklung bestehender Systeme. Darüber hinaus berätst Du unsere Kund:innen bei fachlichen Fragestellungen zur Konzernabschlusserstellung und begleitest spannende Projekte wie Carve-outs oder IPOs als Lucanet-Spezialist:in – von der Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Zusätzlich unterstützt Du die Implementierung von weiteren Lucanet-Lösungen, wie dem Disclosure Management zur Automatisierung der Finanziellen und Nicht-finanziellen Berichterstattung und dem Lease Accounting zur Berechnung und Buchung von IFRS 16 Leasing-Verträgen. Bei der Implementierung des Extended Planning & Analysis (xP&A) zur operativen und integrierten Unternehmenssteuerung kannst du dein Controlling-Wissen perfekt einsetzen. Das Training unserer Kund:innen in den verschiedenen Lucanet-Softwarelösungen macht Deine Aufgaben komplett.
description_en: Do you want to strengthen our Accounting Advisory Services division with your expertise? Then become part of our team and get involved: You will support our customers – from medium-sized businesses to international corporations – in the further development of their finance function. You will support them in optimizing processes relating to the preparation of consolidated financial statements, reporting and financial performance management as well as in the implementation of regulatory requirements according to IFRS and HGB. The main focus of your work is on the implementation and optimization of Lucanet Consolidation & Financial Planning (CFP) as the key FPM software. With your consolidation knowledge, you will support our customers in mapping complex group structures and further developing existing systems. In addition, you will advise our customers on technical issues relating to the preparation of consolidated financial statements and support exciting projects such as carve-outs or IPOs as a Lucanet specialist - from conception to successful implementation. In addition, you support the implementation of other Lucanet solutions, such as disclosure management to automate financial and non-financial reporting and lease accounting to calculate and book IFRS 16 leasing contracts. When implementing Extended Planning & Analysis (xP&A) for operational and integrated corporate management, you can use your controlling knowledge perfectly. Training our customers in the various Lucanet software solutions completes your tasks.

description:
About the Role

Our Transfer Pricing team focuses on helping organizations determine the appropriate pricing for transactions between related parties. We delve into how our clients operate, identify their success factors, uncover where value lies, and ensure alignment with international tax regulations. As a Manager, you'll collaborate with a team of problem solvers who bring extensive consulting and industry experience to address complex business issues, from strategy to execution. Your role includes managing a portfolio of clients, leading technical projects, and contributing to business development activities.

Our team is fuelled by curious minds from diverse backgrounds. As part of our team, you'll work with deep technical specialists in a broad spectrum of areas - together we'll present differentiated thought leadership to our clients. Our investment in technology, alternative delivery models, and knowledge tools will enable you to deliver work efficiently and allow time to focus on interesting and challenging value added advisory work.

What your days will look like

  • Oversee a portfolio of clients and provide regular reports to Senior Managers and above.

  • Lead the delivery of various technical projects, from initial planning stages to documentation and handling inquiries.

  • Manage the financial aspects of client engagements.

  • Participate actively in business development activities to identify and develop opportunities with new and existing clients.

  • Collaborate with specialists from our global network to achieve optimal client outcomes.

  • Train, coach, and supervise junior team members to foster their development.

  • Stay current with relevant regulatory and business issues.

  • Build and maintain internal relationships while enhancing your PwC brand.

The skills & experience we're looking for

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality work and understand clients' businesses and professional standards.

  • Maintain respectful and professional client relationships.

  • Extensive experience advising multinational clients on transfer pricing.

  • Additional experience in corporate tax or related international issues is a plus.

  • Proven ability to manage client portfolios and projects, including all aspects of financial and risk management.

  • Experience in building and maintaining strong internal and external networks.

  • Strong time management skills, with the ability to plan and execute work within tight deadlines.

  • Excellent communication skills, including negotiation and influencing.

  • Ability to provide constructive feedback to help team members improve and grow.

  • Ability to promptly address issues while maintaining high professional standards.

  • Must have an ACA/CTA qualification or international equivalent, or equivalent work experience, including relevant experience in your home country for international candidates.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more
